turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi! How are you doing these days?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A bit tired today, but okay.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I got a D on my last biology test and now I just don't want to study at all.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's a rough feeling. A bad grade can really knock motivation. Do you know what went wrong?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Not really. I thought I knew it.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's actually useful. It might mean you were reading and recognising things, but not testing yourself.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: So what, I just try harder?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Not harder, differently. Go through the test and redo every question you missed, without looking at your notes first.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: A little. But it shows you exactly where the gaps are. One test doesn't decide what you're capable of.
